en: Vintage tinted postcard view of a street and hill in Lublin, showing a winding dirt road in the foreground and a complex of historic buildings with church towers and a large school building on the ridge. The sky is colorized in pinkish-orange, while the townscape and vegetation are in monochrome. Printed Polish text at the top labels the city, street, church, and a trade school.
